description: This file defines an interface IMedia and a template class Media within the Thunder::Core namespace. It provides an abstraction for media operations such as open, close, reset, read, and write, and includes an internal Handler class for managing data transfer and state changes. The file appears to be part of a media handling module, with mechanisms for thread safety and event signaling.
